---
pagetitle: Page not found — OpenSpace
description-meta: >
  The page you requested could not be found.
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
    anchor-sections: false
    theme: assets/style/page/404.scss
---

```{=html}
<section class="page-404">
  <p class="page-404__code" aria-hidden="true">404</p>
  <h1 class="page-404__title">Houston, this page has drifted out of orbit</h1>
  <p class="page-404__lede">
    The page you're looking for may have been moved, renamed, or launched into deep space. Let's get you back on course.
  </p>

  <form class="page-404__search" action="https://duckduckgo.com/" method="get" role="search">
    <label class="visually-hidden" for="page-404-search-input">Search the site</label>
    <input type="search" id="page-404-search-input" name="q" placeholder="Search for the page's new location…">
    <button type="submit" class="button__primary">Search</button>
  </form>
  <script>
    // Scope the search to this site. DuckDuckGo only honors the `site:` operator inside
    // the query (a `sites` form parameter is ignored), so prepend it on submit. Without
    // JS the form still works; it just searches all of DuckDuckGo
    document.querySelector('.page-404__search').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const q = document.getElementById('page-404-search-input').value.trim();
      window.location.href = 'https://duckduckgo.com/?q=' +
        encodeURIComponent('site:www.openspaceproject.com ' + q);
    });
  </script>

  <div class="page-404__actions">
    <a href="index.qmd" class="button__primary">Back to home</a>
    <a href="install/download.qmd" class="button__secondary">Download</a>
    <a href="resources/tutorials.qmd" class="button__secondary">Tutorials</a>
    <a href="community/contact.qmd" class="button__secondary">Contact</a>
  </div>

  <p class="page-404__report">
    Followed a broken link to get here?
    <a href="community/contact.qmd">Let us know</a> or
    <a href="https://github.com/OpenSpace/www.openspaceproject.com/issues">open an issue on GitHub</a>
    so we can fix it.
  </p>
</section>


```
